entries.fd61c90b6400e37a: Based on its management philosophy “Creation Contribution,” the company aims to maximize corporate value toward 2030. For the 3-year medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years ending March 2027 to March 2029, it positions the period as a time to establish a foundation for sustainable growth, and aims, through innovation in new growth areas and strengthening of its management foundation, to achieve both “strengthening current profitability” and “establishing a medium-term growth foundation” as twin pillars.
